correctness.summary: The orthant reduction, spectral-radius condition, regulator identity, occupation-density argument, finite-variation Tanaka identity, and increasing-boundary iff criterion were checked algebraically. The locally absolutely continuous and power-boundary corollaries follow directly from the proved contact-measure formulas.

originality.summary: To the best of our knowledge, the exact subcritical regulator/local-time defect identity, its localization to singular boundary variation, the iff contact-measure criterion for increasing boundaries, and the removal of the Brownian-scale modulus condition for all locally absolutely continuous boundaries are not stated in the inspected sources. The orthant Skorokhod theorem, Wang's modulus-based well-posedness theorem, and Wang's singular Holder counterexamples are treated as prior art.

value.summary: The result identifies the structural source of the new moving-boundary nonexistence phenomenon in the subcritical regime and exhibits solvable critical and subcritical Holder boundaries excluded by the existing positive theorem. Together with the recent singular counterexamples it shows that Holder exponent and total variation alone do not classify solvability.
